label: Splunk Enterprise
description: Splunk Enterprise installed from a .deb package you supply (download URL and SHA-256 from splunk.com).

inputs.name: SPLUNK_ADMIN_PASSWORD
inputs.label: Password for the Splunk admin user (8+ characters, kept in the image)

inputs.name: SPLUNK_ACCEPT_LICENSE
inputs.label: I accept the Splunk software licence agreement

usage: Splunk Web http://<guest-ip>:8000 , user admin. The licence terms you accepted at build time apply to every clone.
